distrust.en: Repeated errors can create distrust between a team and its audience.
distrust.zh: 一再出錯可能在團隊與觀眾之間造成不信任。

disturbing.en: The report contained disturbing evidence about severe environmental damage.
disturbing.zh: 報告中包含令人不安的嚴重環境破壞證據。

divorcee.en: The novel follows a divorcee rebuilding a quiet life in another city.
divorcee.zh: 小說描述一位離婚者在另一座城市重新建立平靜生活。

dogmatic.en: A dogmatic attitude can make open discussion much more difficult.
dogmatic.zh: 過度武斷的態度會讓開放討論變得更困難。

dole.en: The article explains how the dole supported unemployed workers historically.
dole.zh: 文章說明過去失業救濟如何支援失業勞工。

done.en: The assignment was done before the final class meeting began.
done.zh: 作業在最後一次上課開始前就完成了。

doubtless.en: The new library will doubtless become a popular study space.
doubtless.zh: 新圖書館無疑會成為受歡迎的讀書空間。

drainage.en: Improved drainage helped prevent water from collecting beside the road.
drainage.zh: 改善排水後，有助於避免道路旁積水。

drape.en: They decided to drape a cloth over the display before opening.
drape.zh: 他們決定在開幕前用布覆蓋展示品。

drawback.en: One drawback of the plan is its relatively high cost.
drawback.zh: 這項計畫的一個缺點是成本相對較高。

dropout.en: The study examines factors that may affect the school dropout rate.
dropout.zh: 這項研究探討可能影響輟學率的因素。

duke.en: The castle once belonged to a duke from a powerful family.
duke.zh: 這座城堡曾屬於一位出身權勢家族的公爵。

dutiful.en: The dutiful student completed every task carefully and on time.
dutiful.zh: 這名盡責的學生仔細且準時完成每項任務。

dweller.en: Each city dweller experiences urban life in a different way.
dweller.zh: 每位城市居民都以不同方式體驗都市生活。

eagerly.en: Students eagerly gathered around the new science demonstration.
eagerly.zh: 學生興奮地圍到新的科學示範旁。

earnings.en: The report compares company earnings across several recent years.
earnings.zh: 報告比較公司近幾年的收益表現。

earplug.en: An earplug can reduce distracting noise during certain activities.
earplug.zh: 耳塞可以在某些活動中降低干擾噪音。

earthworm.en: An earthworm helps improve soil by moving through it naturally.
earthworm.zh: 蚯蚓自然穿行土壤時，有助於改善土質。

easter.en: The article explains several customs associated with easter celebrations.
easter.zh: 文章介紹與復活節慶祝活動相關的幾項習俗。

eastwards.en: The hikers continued eastwards until they reached the river.
eastwards.zh: 健行者繼續往東走，直到抵達河邊。

economically.en: The region developed economically after transportation links improved.
economically.zh: 交通改善後，這個地區的經濟逐漸發展。

educated.en: An educated audience may still disagree about complex public issues.
educated.zh: 即使是受過教育的觀眾，也可能對複雜公共議題有不同看法。

educator.en: The educator designed activities that encouraged students to ask questions.
educator.zh: 那位教育工作者設計活動，鼓勵學生提問。

eel.en: An eel moved slowly between the rocks in the aquarium.
eel.zh: 一條鰻魚在水族箱的岩石間緩慢游動。

eight.en: Eight students volunteered to help prepare the exhibition.
eight.zh: 八名學生自願協助準備展覽。

eighteen.en: The class collected eighteen responses during the first survey.
eighteen.zh: 班上在第一次調查中收到十八份回覆。

eighty.en: Nearly eighty visitors attended the museum talk that afternoon.
eighty.zh: 那天下午約有八十名訪客參加博物館講座。

elective.en: She chose astronomy as an elective for the spring semester.
elective.zh: 她選擇天文學作為春季學期的選修課。

elemental.en: The lesson introduced elemental composition through a simple chart.
elemental.zh: 課程透過簡單圖表介紹元素組成。

eleven.en: Eleven teams entered the regional science competition this year.
eleven.zh: 今年有十一支隊伍參加區域科學競賽。

elite.en: The article questions whether elite schools always provide better outcomes.
elite.zh: 文章質疑菁英學校是否總能帶來更好的結果。

embargo.en: The history class studied how an embargo affected international trade.
embargo.zh: 歷史課研究禁運如何影響國際貿易。

embark.en: The research team will embark on a new project next month.
embark.zh: 研究團隊下個月將展開一項新計畫。

embody.en: These examples embody the main principles described in the report.
embody.zh: 這些例子體現了報告中描述的主要原則。

embryo.en: The biology textbook explains early embryo development with diagrams.
embryo.zh: 生物課本用圖解說明早期胚胎發育。

enchant.en: The colorful lanterns seemed to enchant visitors after sunset.
enchant.zh: 日落後，繽紛燈籠似乎深深吸引了遊客。

encouraging.en: The latest test results were encouraging for the research group.
encouraging.zh: 最新測試結果對研究團隊而言相當令人振奮。

endless.en: The coastline seemed endless from the top of the hill.
endless.zh: 從山頂望去，海岸線彷彿沒有盡頭。

enlist.en: The club hopes to enlist more volunteers for the community project.
enlist.zh: 社團希望為社區計畫招募更多志工。

ensue.en: Further debate may ensue if the proposal remains unclear.
ensue.zh: 如果提案仍不清楚，可能會接著出現更多辯論。

entail.en: The new plan will entail several changes to the schedule.
entail.zh: 新計畫將涉及幾項時程變動。

envisage.en: The designers envisage a quieter and more flexible study area.
envisage.zh: 設計者構想一個更安靜、更有彈性的學習空間。

enzyme.en: An enzyme can speed up a chemical reaction in living cells.
enzyme.zh: 酵素可以加快活細胞中的化學反應。

epic.en: The class read an epic about a long and difficult journey.
epic.zh: 班上閱讀了一篇描寫漫長艱難旅程的史詩。

epigram.en: The writer ended the essay with a short and memorable epigram.
epigram.zh: 作者以一句簡短而令人難忘的警句作結。

err.en: Even experienced researchers can err when data are incomplete.
err.zh: 即使有經驗的研究者，在資料不完整時也可能犯錯。

essentially.en: The two methods are essentially similar despite minor differences.
essentially.zh: 這兩種方法雖有小差異，但本質上相似。

etiquette.en: Good classroom etiquette includes listening while others are speaking.
etiquette.zh: 良好的課堂禮儀包括在別人發言時專心聆聽。

exceedingly.en: The final puzzle was exceedingly difficult for most participants.
exceedingly.zh: 最後一道謎題對大多數參與者而言極為困難。

exclusively.en: The room is used exclusively for music practice after school.
exclusively.zh: 這個房間放學後專門用於音樂練習。
